brief:
The Palestinian Red Crescent Society said its teams in Salfit were treating two people shot with live ammunition following an attack on the town of Yasouf, the Ma'an news agency reported. One victim, a 50-year-old man, sustained a gunshot wound to the abdomen, while the other was hit by a live bullet fragment in the side.

The Red Crescent attributed the shootings to an attack by settlers on the locality.

title: Red Crescent treats two live gunshot wounds in Salfit attack
